claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spellOptionRestriction
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current magic-item activation surface can model shared charges, dawn recharge, fixed save DC, and multiple granted spells, but it cannot narrow an existing spell grant to only specific authored modes or commands. Encoding Command here as unrestricted would be mechanically false.

discrepancies: no content/magic_item_wand_of_fear.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
